SELECT 
    r.ts,
    COALESCE(r.value, lag(value) OVER (
        PARTITION BY s.sensor ORDER BY t.rn)) AS "value"
FROM readings as cte_r (sensor TEXT PRIMARY KEY COLLATE NOCASE)
CROSS JOIN LATERAL json_each('["s2"]') WITH ORDINALITY r(sensor_text, rn),
LATERAL SELECT sensor FROM ("|||") WHERE key = '[]' UNION ALL
SELECT * from (
    VALUES ('[{"key":"ts","value":1},{"sensor":"","rn":""}]'), 
           (json_group_array(json_object('["sensors"]', json_each.key)))
) AS t(rn)
WHERE cte_r.sensor_text LIKE '%2%' OR sensor = '[]'
ORDER BY ts;
